title: ID0429798-DC/Si-D/DE- [Y2 / S5 313657916001] Station shining white
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Sicharge charging Center is active but white and our Complany
Logo is not there anymore. Siemens Startlogo with "hello" and the
cars on the screen. Seems to be there was an update that doesnt
work? in my chargecloud app the Charging station is flagged active
but not available atm and the station shining white. It is a very
strong weekend with holiday to a lot of people needs to charge and
a fast help would be very nice.

additional_info.subject: ID0429798-DC/Si-D/DE- [Y2 / S5 313657916001] Station shining white CRM:01282001014
additional_info.body:
Hello
Hope you are doing well.
Unfortunately, we cannot do much remotely when we don't have SCB connection. The best would be to have someone on site to check, Hence handing over to RC for below checks.
The router is connected to internet.
The charger is powered.
kindly refer the below points which might be the reason to out the charger on SCB.
Then there might be Internet issue with the Siemens router and probably because of failover function the WAN is switched from Cellular to Ethernet.
I would recommend doing a Hard reset from "OCPP" (If charger is connected to OCPP server) or a local reboot will bring them up again.
Data service of mobile network operator might not be available.- SIM card might be disabled / expired (Please check if the SIM card is inserted incorrectly by cleaning and then reinserting it into the XF3 and XF4 router.)- monthly data volume exhausted- signal strength got weak due to changed radio transmission conditions- in case of M2M contracts is IP not enabled
,
There might be backend related issues.- Backend changed the settings for the affected charger- OCPP server on Backend side unavailable
It could be Teltonika related issues.- Router switches to a wrong network service (e.g. 3G instead of 4G)- Hardware failure of Router- Router software crash
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
X
End Customer Communication
X
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2) and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution and send survey email to the customer.
​​​​​​​
With best regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavy Gurav

additional_info.body:

SCB offline aber sendet trotzdem Logs. Charger außer Betrieb.
Mit R&D lokalen SSH Zugang eingerichtet und Cfast Card
gemounted. Rausgefunden, dass 'offline-error-flags.json' Datei
korrupt ist. Diese gelöscht und Charger wieder in Betrieb
genommen. Abschließender Funktionstest erfolgreich.
